ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (black) distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Dominant white central field (approx. 80% of lobe) with a solid black border along the trailing edge and distal tip. Right lobe: Large dark medial field extending from the notch, transitioning to a white distal field containing dense vertical dark striations and irregular black mottling near the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees; vertex depth is partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; prominent jagged peaks (approx. 10-15px) observed on the distal right lobe; finer, saw-tooth serrations (3-5px) along the medial trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating at the median notch and extending toward the acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel clusters located on the dark distal tips of both lobes; isolated dark focal spots are scattered within the white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical dark linear striations observed on the outer white section of the right lobe, breaking the primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent bumpy, high-relief white textures on the extreme tips of both lobes consistent with barnacle colonization; irregular, asymmetric trailing edge profile on the rightmost extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark comma-shaped pigmentation mark located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe's white field.
